scope: Focused final review of automatic seed startup, identity protection, initialization deadlines, SDK request lifecycle patch and deployment metadata/policies.
verified_behaviors: Initial to Initializing reservation is held briefly; broker/KMS I/O occurs outside the phase lock. Failed/expired recovery returns to Initial and cannot sign.

Existing S3 ciphertext is reused regardless of whether the optional expected identity pin is configured. Only explicit absence without a pin reaches GenerateDataKey and conditional create; read/decrypt failures never enter replacement generation.
A configured identity pin blocks missing-state generation/write and rejects a different recovered identity before Active. First startup has no creation setting or replacement setting.
Ingress, custody, broker and helper deadlines shrink from absolute limits. Late completed recovery cannot activate; a late S3 conditional PUT is recovered by the next load.

The exact maintained SDK source patch initializes cleanup pointers, checks partial allocations and uses a mutex-protected completion predicate. TLS, SigV4, attestation and CMS remain official implementations.

The release gate verifies actual EIF measurements and measured public configuration, infers image classification from the identity pin, and preserves operational retirement of generation authority before funding.

retained_native_evidence.notes: Native helper, patch and regression source bytes match the earlier tested revision. Final configuration/runtime/EIF evidence remains separate.

residuals: The separate upstream connection-setup unconditional wait can lose an early notification; the helper12-second deadline bounds this availability failure and initialization fails closed.

An unpinned identity cannot authenticate an existing same-context seed against a dishonest broker. Pin the independently verified identity and retire generation authority before funding; backup/restore validation remains required.
Inherited conditional webpki and optional Helios dependency matches remain documented in REMEDIATION.md; no package inputs or upstream native coordinates changed.
No real AWS/Nitro policy enforcement or production backup recovery was performed by this offline review.
